query purchaseOrderFindone($company: Int, $purchaseOrderNumber: String!) {
  purchaseOrderFindone(
    company: $company
    purchaseOrderNumber: $purchaseOrderNumber
  ) {
    headerLowestSts: lowestStatusPurchaseOrder
    requisitionBy
    customerGeneric {
      buyerDivision: alphanumericField122Positions
      __typename
    }
    purchaseOrderLine {
      customerGeneric {
        vpo: alphaField30Positions
        supplierTolerance: alphaField30PositionsF1A130
        stockZone: alphaField30PositionsF1A230
        __typename
      }
      responsibleForFollowUp
      purchaseOrderNumber
      purchaseOrderLine
      purchaseOrderLineSubnumber
      itemNumber
      supplier
      requestedDeliveryDate
      purchasePrice
      previouslyConfirmedDeliveryDate
      confirmedDeliveryDate
      deviatingConfirmedDeliveryDate
      planningDate
      purchasePriceQuantity
      purchaseOrderUM
      purchasePriceUM
      deliveryMethod
      deliveryTerms
      goodsReceivingMethod
      harborOrAirport
      midSpec: monitoringActivityList
      resonCode: technicalSupervisor
      orderedQuantityAlternateUM
      agreementNumber
      discount: discount1
      warehouse
      lineStatus: lowestStatusPurchaseOrder
      confirmedQuantity
      transportNotifiedQuantity
      buyer
      purchasePriceText
      lineAmountOrderCurrency
      referenceOrderNumber
      referenceOrderLine
      agreement: ourReferenceNumber
      purchaseOrderItemName
      purchaseOrderItemDescription
      priority
      supplierItemNumber
      lineCharges {
        purchaseOrderNumber
        purchaseOrderLine
        purchaseOrderLineSubnumber
        costingElementAmount
        __typename
      }
      item {
        mainItem: userDefinedField1Item
        itemName: name
        skuDescription: description2
        parentItem {
          parentDescription: description2
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      itemSupplier {
        itemNumber
        supplierItemDescription
        supplierItemName
        supplierItemNumber
        __typename
      }
      style {
        optionItem {
          colorName: text
          __typename
        }
        sizeCode: optionSize
        sizeName: nameSize
        zFeatureCode: optionZ
        zFeatureName: name
        styleNumber
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
